title: Easy to use, but a bit small
text: Easy to use, but a bit small. This is a well made product, I'm sure it will last us a long time!  Easy to adjust the coarseness of the grind. The grinding takes a bit of time, worth it for a better cup of coffee, but don't use if you are in a rush!  We make our coffee strong, so we had to do two separate fill ups, so it took a while, but the end result was great!
